assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D sprite for an existing ancient Chinese blacksmith casual game. Match attached reference's simple rounded sticker drawing: thick continuous dark brown #5a3220 outline, warm flat colors, just one soft shadow tone and small cream top-left highlights. Avoid photorealism, 3D, elaborate texture, gradients, typography, text, letters, watermark. Square composition, single isolated design centered filling 80 percent, entire silhouette within canvas with generous transparent margins. Real transparent alpha background, no checkerboard drawn in image, no panel or surrounding scenery. Readable downscaled to 80–140 pixels. Subject: a small friendly living furnace flame, teardrop-shaped chubby golden-orange body with three rounded flame tips, red-orange outer rim and warm butter-yellow center; two tiny dark-brown oval eyes, smiling mouth and soft rosy cheeks. No limbs, no accessories, no floor or shadow. The main character for a dodge-water/catch-charcoal minigame. Two tiny detached ember droplets close to the top are okay. Reference 1 is style only, reference 2 is facial mood only; do not draw a hammer or a rectangular ingot.
